senses.gloss:
बडवा f. (-वा)
 1. A mare.
 2. A female slave.
 3. The nymph AŚHWINI,
or the personified asterism which is designated by a horse's head.
E. बल strength or force, and वा to go to, affs. क and टाप्, and ल
change to ड ।

बाडव m. (-वः)
 1. Submarine fire.
 2. A Brāhman.
 n. (-वं) A stud, a col-
lection of mares.
 E. वाडव a mare, and अण् aff. of derivation: see
बडवानल ।

बडवाकृ(हृ)त m. (-तः) The gallant of a female slave, and thence also a
slave.
 E. बडवा and कृत or हृत taken.

बडवाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Submarine fire: see the next.
 E. बडवा a mare, and अग्नि fire.

बाडवाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Hell.
 E. बडवाग्नि submarine fire, and अण् aff. of place.

बडवानल m. (-लः) Submarine fire; in mythology, a being consisting
of flame, but with the head of a mare, who sprang from the thighs
of AURVA^1, and was received by the ocean.
 E. बडवा a mare, and
अनल fire.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260525. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/236.

बडवामुख m. (-खः) Submarine fire: see बडवानल.
 n. (-लं) The infernal
regions.
 E. वडबा a mare, and मुख head, principal.

बडवासुत m. dual. (-तौ) The two sons of AŚHWINĪ and the physicians of
heaven.
 E. बडवा the nymph AŚHWINĪ and सुत a son.

बाड (ऋ) बाडृ r. 1st cl. (बाडते) To bathe, to dive and emerge. Vopadeva
differs from other authorities in writing this with an initial व ।

बाडवेय m. du. (-यौ) The two sons of ĀSHWINĪ and physicians of Swar-
ga.
 E. बडवा a mare, Sanjaya changed into a mare, and टक् aff. of
descent.

बाडव्य n. (-व्यं) A number of Brāhmans.
 E. बाडव a Brāhman, यत् aff.
बाडीर m. (-रः) A servant, a hired labourer.
